The orchestrator guard (kit_orchestrator_guard.py), its gaps and a fix for each:
1. Sessions started before it (orchestrator 50) do not load it: the next orchestrator does. Fix: none needed; I follow it by hand.
2. create_session passes when 'docs/prompts/' appears anywhere in the prompt, so a long inline prompt that names a path passes. Fix: the prompt must start with 'Your prompt is docs/prompts/<id>.md' and be under ~300 characters.
3. A title containing 'review' or 'clerk' passes. Fix: pass by tag only (board-clerk, orchestrator, review), not title.
4. Subagents are exempt by design (they keep dumps out of the orchestrator), so a raw dump by a subagent is allowed; that is the intended route, not a gap.
5. Raw reads through Bash or the Artifact read of the page are not covered. Fix: the guard also refuses ArtifactData list/query of repos/<id>/posts|comments (attached boards), which it may not match today.
Waiting for your word before a part changes the guard.
